== English Official Tournament Sealed Deck comparison ==
Decipher expressly states that the printed ‘here’ on Red Squadron X-wing means on that starship, and that the revised wording reads ‘aboard’. It also removes a redundant ‘aboard’ from the description of a built-in pilot. The full published text change leaves the deploy discount, permanent pilot ability and power, and free Proton Torpedoes on the same starship intact.
